title: NON_EXPANSION_RESULT_SCHEMA_v0.1
description: Strict result contract for the Non-Expansion Operator. Freezes the comparison of a generated claim against its source-authority claim. All semantic containment decisions that cannot be expressed in pure JSON Schema are assigned to the REFERENCE_NON_EXPANSION_EVALUATOR and must fail closed.

schema_version.description: Version of this result schema. Must remain exactly "0.1" for conformance with NON_EXPANSION_RESULT_SCHEMA_v0.1.

operator_version.description: Version of the Non-Expansion Operator that produced this result.

schema_digest.description: Optional but recommended. SHA-256 digest of the canonical schema document used for validation. Format: sha256:<hex>.

result_id.description: Optional unique identifier for this specific non-expansion result instance.

claim_id.description: Identifier of the generated claim under evaluation (e.g., C-017).

source_evidence_ids.description: Non-empty set of evidence identifiers that authorize the source claim. Order is not significant.

comparison.description: Aggregate comparison status derived from the four dimension classification arrays.

expanded_dimensions.description: Dimensions in which the generated claim is a strict superset of the source (expansion).

narrowed_dimensions.description: Dimensions in which the generated claim is a strict subset of the source (narrowing).

equal_dimensions.description: Dimensions in which the generated claim is equal to the source.

indeterminate_dimensions.description: Dimensions for which the required subset/superset/equality/strictness relation cannot be proven. Any non-empty value forces comparison=UNRESOLVED, r15_triggered=true, and publication_eligible=false.

reason_codes.description: Closed vocabulary of machine-readable reason codes explaining the comparison outcome. Must be non-empty when comparison is not EQUAL.

publication_eligible.description: True only when comparison is EQUAL or NARROWED AND indeterminate_dimensions is empty AND no expansion exists. False in all other cases.

r15_triggered.description: Must be true exactly when indeterminate_dimensions is non-empty. Represents R15_VERIFICATION_INDETERMINATE.

notes.description: Optional human-readable notes. Must not be used as a substitute for reason_codes or dimension classifications.

dimension_name.description: Closed set of dimensions evaluated by the Non-Expansion Operator.

reason_code.description: Closed vocabulary of reason codes. R15_VERIFICATION_INDETERMINATE must appear whenever r15_triggered is true.

allOf.description: R15 invariant: any indeterminate dimension forces UNRESOLVED + r15_triggered=true + publication_eligible=false and requires the R15 reason code.
Any expansion forces comparison=EXPANDED and publication_eligible=false (provided no indeterminacy, which already forces UNRESOLVED).
Narrowing without expansion or indeterminacy forces comparison=NARROWED.
All dimensions equal (no expansion, narrowing, or indeterminacy) forces comparison=EQUAL.
publication_eligible may be true only for EQUAL or NARROWED with zero indeterminacy.
When comparison is not EQUAL, at least one reason_code must be present.
